args.sql:
WITH SuperfanCriteria AS (
    SELECT definition
    FROM external_knowledge
    WHERE name = 'Superfan'
),
FanData AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry, 
        f.nicklabel AS nickname, 
        f.tierstep AS tier_level, 
        e.socintscore AS engagement_score, 
        m.spendusd AS financial_contribution, 
        f.statustag AS fan_status
    FROM 
        fans f
    JOIN 
        engagement e ON f.userregistry = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN 
        membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    WHERE 
        f.statustag = 'Active'
),
SuperfanLabel AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.*, 
        CASE 
            WHEN fd.engagement_score > (SELECT AVG(socintscore) FROM engagement) 
            AND fd.financial_contribution > (SELECT AVG(spendusd) FROM membershipandspending) 
            THEN 'Superfan' 
            ELSE 'Regular Fan' 
        END AS fan_label
    FROM 
        FanData fd
)
SELECT 
    nickname, 
    tier_level, 
    engagement_score, 
    financial_contribution, 
    fan_label
FROM 
    SuperfanLabel
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC, 
    financial_contribution DESC;
